rationale: This is a cosmetic variant of the archive's already-tested Interest Rollover Squeeze — the identical (xint − oibdp)/at × dlc/lt structure with dp merely added inside the numerator — so it re-tests an evaluated signal rather than a new mechanism.

Despite the "novel interaction" label this is a single unconditional ratio whose cross-sectional variation will be dominated by −oibdp/at plus a current-liability accrual term, i.e. a mechanical repackaging of the operating-profitability and liability-accrual anomalies rather than a genuine cross-theme construct.

Replacing symmetric profitability volatility with a directional distance-from-peak measure is a substantively different and economically coherent response to the failed vol×leverage signal, and the expression's sign direction matches the stated hypothesis.

The first leg (Δche − oibdp)/at is dominated by negative profitability rather than by "debt-funded liquidity," so the expression does not compute the stated mechanism and the composite largely collapses into low-profitability × debt-issuance, both documented anomalies.

The first leg loads positively on oiadp, so profitable dividend payers score high on a signal expected to predict low returns — an internal sign conflict with the profitability anomaly — and the construction closely echoes the archive's already-tested Operating Profit Leakage Under Deficit.

The earnings-quality-deterioration leg is a different economic channel from the archive's interest-coverage signal and the direction is internally consistent, though it leans on the well-known accrual anomaly and reuses the dlc/lt conditioner, so the incremental novelty is moderate.
